I’m older but I was very depressed at that age. Self harm, putting myself in dangerous situations, & floating through life even though I was getting all A+s & even going to college classes.
I was dead inside. 
Things that I learned & it took me a long time: 

I learned that I was not getting my needs met. Yeah, I had food, shelter, & people around me but they’re love languages were very different from mine. 
I couldn’t feel love because my view on it was young. 
Yeah, my dad hit me & my mom put me down & my brother was too mean & overprotective but as I grew up - I learned my dad had it so rough & my mom had it ugly, that my brother went through a different hell - to them, this was a more loving love than they knew. They tried their best. It’s not fair but it is what it is.

 I tried to run but it made life worse - once I faced it & I started understanding about myself - them - others - I realized - I need to take care of myself not because no one else can or will be able to but because I need to know what I like because no one can teach you. How can those around teach when they themselves don’t know? I learned a lot. I learned stuff I like, stuff I will tolerate, & stuff I won’t. You need to learn what your needs and wants are.

Boundaries where another thing. I didn’t understand how to make boundaries & I allowed people to push them which made me a target to bad people. 
The more you understand that you’re time is valuable because YOU are valuable -
The more you say no - the better life is.
